csv_project_name: AE for Building 35 Heat Plant Controls Systems Upgrade
csv_agency: Colorado Department of Human Services CDHS
csv_scope_of_work: The Division of Facilities Management (DFM) of the Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) is selecting an Architect/Engineer/Consultant (A/E) team to design the replacement of outdated heat plant controls and operating systems with modern controls and operating systems. The heat plant on the CMHHIP campus is a 24/7/365 facility operated by the Department of Human Services and provides 125# steam and soft water to over 60 facilities (including the Colorado Mental Health Hospital in Pueblo, three Department of Corrections facilities, a Department of Youth Services Center and a central kitchen that provides daily meals to thousands of patients and inmates) for heat, domestic hot water and meal preparation. The heat plant consists of two coal boilers and two dual-fuel boilers (natural gas and diesel). The existing supervisory controls were installed in 2004 and function on obsolete operating systems (Windows XP and Windows 10) and the PLC controls are outdated/legacy items that can typically only be sourced on the secondary market or from abroad. The aim of this project is to design a project to replace these outdated legacy controls with modern boiler controls that are more robust and fault tolerant
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering
